definitions.explanation: A meeting held to explain something to a group of people, such as a company presentation for job seekers or a school information session for prospective students.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{説明会|せつめいかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I attended a company information session.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいシステムの{説明会|せつめいかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: An information session about the new system will be held.

examples.japanese: {入学|にゅうがく}{説明会|せつめいかい}は4{月|がつ}にあります。
examples.english: The enrollment information session is in April.

notes:
{説明会|せつめいかい} combines {説明|せつめい} (explanation) + {会|かい} (meeting/gathering).

COMMON TYPES:
- {会社|かいしゃ}/{企業|きぎょう}{説明会|せつめいかい} (company information session for job seekers)
- {入学|にゅうがく}/{学校|がっこう}{説明会|せつめいかい} (school enrollment information session)
- {商品|しょうひん}{説明会|せつめいかい} (product briefing)
- {住民|じゅうみん}{説明会|せつめいかい} (residents' briefing)

USAGE NOTES:
- Very common in Japanese business and academic contexts
- Company {説明会|せつめいかい} are an important part of the job hunting (就活) process
